definitions.explanation: Sound in general, especially as a technical or artistic concept. Also refers to acoustics as a field or the audio quality of a space or system.

{音響|おんきょう} is used in technical and artistic contexts to talk about sound quality, audio systems, and acoustics. In everyday conversation, ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ is more common for referring to sound in general.
